policy: Player unified/fresh/bounded/manual, both linked, centerline player, power both, limbSever true, gravity9.81, legacy support, GAIT.assist.3. Enemy ordinary legacy arm.

fixtures.natural: Seed7 authored low guard vs actual normal AI. No injury/state/force injection.
fixtures.lying: Passive opponent; tick360 knockDown(true)+one chest worldX impulse55Ns; actual native floor lying.
fixtures.side: As lying but chest worldZ impulse55Ns.
fixtures.hurt: As lying plus front-leg controller health .45 at tick360; synthetic function loss, not real wound.

iterationChanges.r1: Pose-only lead latch/load wait/trailing flat goal; worsening unsupported trailing foot.
iterationChanges.r2: Preserve lead foot orientation; trailing flat goal rather than high ankle latch; begin last kneel load window. Worsening/slip/fallback remains.
iterationChanges.r3: Synchronize kn/pelvis rise and reachable height with actual foot phases; bounded fallback. Desired-position gate stalls rise.
iterationChanges.r4: Accept actual continuously contacting loaded footprint and preserve actual trailing orientation; height fallback continuity; unreachable horizontal geometry handled. Actual phase exposure improves but natural/lying/hurt fallbacks and slip regressions remain.
iterationChanges.r5: Separate late-getup reuse of existing Gait sense/plantAt/begin/target/pinFeet/poseLegs; active=false, original kn and stand timing, no mass/enter/update/touchdown calls. Includes existing friction and reciprocal swingPull force. Rear-foot support improves in3conditions while lead support worsens inall4; not accepted.

notClaimed: Natural death comparison across unequal observation endpoints.
All model/control/native-world values finite: only recorded body/joint values checked.
R1 joint-gap audit: gap instrumentation begins r2.
Same two-second end window across different physical trajectories: windows start at each first stand; candidate may die earlier.

rawMetadataCorrections: Raw observed means legacy baseline; replay means plant candidate, not read-only instrumentation replay.

nextBoundary: A coherent torso load-transfer and two-foot support controller is needed; further coefficient tuning of these five rejected candidates or restoration of rejected COM carry is not proposed.
